description: Make printable bingo cards, every card different, with a call list. mode "words" for any theme or vocabulary; "pictures" for children who cannot read yet (picture names, or a picture_group); "numbers" for classic 1 to 75 bingo; "find_someone_who" for icebreaker human bingo (each square is something a person might have done, e.g. "has a pet"). Up to 100 cards.

call_list.description: A call list to cut out and draw from, at the end.

decoration.description: A themed border with matching pictures, drawn around the sheet: "line" for a plain border, "none" for nothing, or a theme such as halloween, christmas, thanksgiving, spring, dinosaurs, space, ocean, animals, birthday, back-to-school (95 themes; find_printables shows a theme’s name). Leave out for no border.

dyslexia_font.description: Print in OpenDyslexic, a typeface some readers with dyslexia find easier.

free_space.description: A free space in the middle of 3 × 3 and 5 × 5 cards (on unless turned off).

grid_size.description: Squares per side: 3, 4 or 5. Picture bingo is usually 3 or 4.

items.description: The words for the squares (words, find_someone_who), or picture names for picture bingo. Give more than the squares on a card (24 for 5 × 5) so cards differ: 30 to 40 is best.

large.description: Bigger, bolder words for young children and beginning readers (for older eyes, use large_print).

large_print.description: Large print for older eyes or low vision: bigger, bolder letters and roomier layouts (sizes are capped to fit). For young children, use large.

mode.description: What goes in the squares: words, pictures, numbers, or find_someone_who.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

picture_group.description: Picture bingo: use a whole group of the site’s pictures instead of (or as well as) items.

picture_names.description: Picture bingo: print each picture’s name under it.

picture_style.description: Picture bingo: color or mono (black and white, to save ink).

seed.description: Which random version to make. Leave out for a fresh one; pass the seed from an earlier result to keep that version while changing other settings.

title.description: The title printed at the top of the sheet, e.g. "Thanksgiving Bingo". Keep it short.

name: make_bingo_cards

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Bingo cards
